security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, and prose examples rather than executable package code. The six parent-directory references in SKILL.md are confirmed because they point agents toward sibling directories outside the skill package boundary. No prompt injection, credential access, network exfiltration, or hidden executable payload was found.

remediation.issue: Parent-directory references point outside the packaged skill.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the ../ sibling skill references with in-package examples, copied reference files, or plain names that do not instruct filesystem traversal.

content.value_statement: Plugin authors need clear guidance to build skills that trigger reliably and stay compact. This skill provides a structured workflow for planning, writing, organizing, and validating Claude Code plugin skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md file and optional references, examples, scripts, and assets.
Guides authors from concrete use cases to reusable skill resources.
Shows how to write frontmatter descriptions with specific trigger phrases.
Defines writing style expectations for concise, imperative skill instructions.
Provides validation checks for structure, descriptions, references, examples, and testing.
Describes where plugin skills live and how Claude Code discovers them.
limitations: Does not include executable validation scripts in this package.
Focuses on Claude Code plugin skills, not every AI skill marketplace format.
Requires the author to supply domain examples, references, and assets.
Some sibling skill references use parent-directory paths that may not exist in packaged installs.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Plugin Skill
use_cases.description: Turn user scenarios into a focused skill structure with the right supporting resources.

use_cases.title: Improve Skill Triggering
use_cases.description: Rewrite weak descriptions into precise trigger phrases that help Claude load the skill at the right time.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Organization
use_cases.description: Check whether long instructions should move into references, examples, or scripts for better context use.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a plan for a Claude Code plugin skill that helps with [task]. Include trigger phrases, core workflow, and needed resources.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Skill Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft the content for a Claude Code plugin skill about [domain]. Use concise imperative instructions and clear trigger phrases.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Supporting Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill idea and decide what should go in SKILL.md, references, examples, scripts, or assets: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing Claude Code plugin skill for trigger quality, progressive disclosure, structure, and validation gaps: [paste summary].

output_examples.input: I need a skill for creating plugin settings documentation.
output: A concise skill purpose statement and specific trigger phrases.
A recommended structure with SKILL.md for core workflow and references for detailed patterns.
A validation checklist covering frontmatter, examples, referenced files, and writing style.

output_examples.input: My skill description is vague and triggers too often.
output: A revised third-person description with concrete user phrases.
A short explanation of why each trigger matches the intended workflow.
A list of phrases to avoid because they are too broad.

output_examples.input: Review whether this skill has too much content in SKILL.md.
output: A separation plan for core instructions, detailed references, examples, and scripts.
A shorter SKILL.md outline focused on essential workflow steps.
A list of referenced resources that must exist before publishing.

best_practices: Start from concrete user requests before choosing the skill structure.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed material into referenced files.
Validate frontmatter, trigger phrases, writing style, and referenced resources before publishing.
anti_patterns: Using vague descriptions that do not include specific trigger phrases.
Putting all detailed guidance into SKILL.md instead of progressive resources.
Referencing examples, scripts, or directories that are missing from the package.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create and improve skills for Claude Code plugins.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete plugin?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on the skill portion of a plugin, including structure, content, and validation guidance.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace report marks it as compatible with Codex, Claude, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include scripts?
faq.answer: No executable scripts are included in this package. It describes when scripts can be useful.

faq.question: What makes a good skill description?
faq.answer: A good description uses third person and includes specific phrases that users would say.

faq.question: How should long skill content be handled?
faq.answer: Keep core workflow in SKILL.md and move detailed guidance into references, examples, or scripts.
